restaurant.name: Borchardt
restaurant.directions: From your current position head towards Gendarmenmarkt. Borchardt is on Französische Straße, about 400 m north of the square.
restaurant.description: Classic Berlin brasserie. Schnitzel, seafood, historic setting. Popular with politicians and celebrities.

restaurant.name: Curry 36
restaurant.directions: From your current position take Mehringdamm south. Curry 36 is on the right, near the U-Bahn station. About 600 m.
restaurant.description: Legendary currywurst stand. Berlin's most famous fast food. Open late, queues are part of the experience.

restaurant.name: Zur letzten Instanz
restaurant.directions: From your current position go east towards Alexanderplatz. Zur letzten Instanz is on Waisenstraße, about 500 m from the TV tower.
restaurant.description: Oldest restaurant in Berlin, since 1621. Traditional German dishes. Historic cellar and courtyard.

restaurant.name: Tim Raue
restaurant.directions: From your current position head to Kreuzberg. Tim Raue is on Rudi-Dutschke-Straße, near Checkpoint Charlie. About 800 m.
restaurant.description: Two Michelin stars. Asian-inspired fine dining. Creative tasting menus, sleek modern interior.

shopping.name: Mustafa's Gemüse Kebap
shopping.directions: From your current position take Mehringdamm. Mustafa's is the famous kebab stand on the corner. Expect a queue. About 600 m.
shopping.description: Iconic Berlin street food. Vegetable kebab with feta and sauces. Long queues, worth the wait.

shopping.name: KaDeWe Food Hall
shopping.directions: From your current position head to Wittenbergplatz. KaDeWe is the large department store on Tauentzienstraße. The food hall is on the sixth floor.
shopping.description: Europe's largest department store food hall. Gourmet delicatessen, restaurants, and champagne bar. A Berlin institution.

shopping.name: Markthalle Neun
shopping.directions: From your current position go to Kreuzberg. Markthalle Neun is on Eisenbahnstraße near Görlitzer Park. About 1 km east.
shopping.description: Historic market hall. Street Food Thursday, regional produce, and small eateries. Lively and authentic.
